exposure: Treatment received (in the context of studies applying the method)
outcome: Effect of treatment (estimated using the method)
cohort: N/A (This is a review of a statistical method, not an empirical study with a participant cohort.)
finding: The latent class instrumental variable (IV) method, which estimates the effect of treatment received under specific assumptions (exclusion restriction, monotonicity) in scenarios of all-or-none compliance or availability, is reviewed for its clinical and biostatistical perspectives, underlying assumptions, methodological extensions, and applications in fields such as obstetrics and cancer research.
